insight: Built by South Korea's Naver and launched in 2017; 'Papago' is Esperanto for 'parrot,' nodding to its language focus.
name: Papago
tagline: Naver's free neural translator, tuned for East Asian languages.
description: Papago is Naver's free AI translation app, covering 14 languages with text, voice, image, and handwriting input. Its neural machine translation is especially strong on East Asian pairs — Korean to and from Japanese, English, and Chinese — making it a go-to for travel and study across the region. Available on the web and as iOS and Android apps.
edge: Tuned for East Asian languages — best-in-class Korean to/from Japanese and English accuracy, free across mobile and web.
bestFor: Travel and study in East Asia
